dataset.name: csi_fingerprint
dataset.crs: local grid (one per area; see building)
dataset.pos_units: grid steps of the area's reference-point grid (spacing not stated by the source)
dataset.citation: Zhu, Qiu, Qu, Zhou, Atiquzzaman, Wu, BLS-Location: A Wireless Fingerprint Localization Algorithm Based on Broad Learning, IEEE TMC 22(1), 2023

protocol.name: benchmarks.protocols:POINT_KFOLD_5
protocol.summary: 5 folds over reference points (groups['point']): every point is tested once and never seen in training (GroupKFold rule of indoorloc.evaluation.kfold, seeded)

tables.units: grid steps of the area's reference-point grid (spacing not stated by the source)

skips.en: the Torres-Sospedra representations are defined for RSSI in dBm, not CSI
skips.zh: Torres-Sospedra 表示针对 dBm 的 RSSI，不适用于 CSI

skips.en: model-based RSSI methods; the CSI amplitude is not a received power per anchor
skips.zh: 基于 RSSI 模型的方法；CSI 幅度不是每个锚点的接收功率

notes.en: Errors are in grid steps of the area's reference-point grid (spacing not stated). Every test point is absent from training, so this measures interpolation to new positions; a random packet split would score almost 0 (point recognition). Features: 3 x 30 amplitudes in dB as stored; the few zero amplitudes (-inf dB, NaN after loading: 48 values in the lab, none in the other three areas) are set to -15 dB, below every stored value.
notes.zh: 误差单位为该区域参考点网格的步长（未给出间距）。测试点都不在训练集中，因此衡量的是向新位置的插值；随机按包划分几乎为 0（只是识别参考点）。特征：3 × 30 个 dB 幅度（原样）；极少数零幅度（-inf dB，加载后为 NaN：实验室 48 个，其他三个区域没有）置为 -15 dB，低于所有存储值。

floor_accuracy.definition: percentage of test samples whose floor is estimated correctly (floor hit rate)

literature.rule: shown: literature entries checked 'verified', 'corrected' or 'unchecked'; hidden: 'unidentified', 'missing' and numbers IndoorLoc 0.1 produced itself
